name: Ulan-Ude

routes.outcome: Official state Buryatia cadastral-valuation agency notice says the public cadastral map moved on 2024-12-23 to NSPD and is accessed through the NSPD Maps section. It also states that the platform provides public cadastral-map services and links to NSPD.
Direct HTTPS GET from the research host timed out after 20 seconds; no viewer HTML/configuration was retrieved. TLS verification was not disabled.

The current public client route was inspected from the published NSPD client configuration pattern, but the host timed out before a response could be obtained. No schema or layer metadata is asserted from this attempt.

Bounded anonymous WMS GetFeatureInfo request for the land-plot layer at the exact WUP point, using EPSG:4326 and a small tile BBOX, timed out after 20 seconds. No feature count, ID, attributes, or geometry was received.

A city-specific Ulan-Ude/Buryatia cadastral-map page was found, but its page states it is not an official Rosreestr, EGRN, or government site. It was treated only as discovery context, not as registry or geometry evidence.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not verified because the official viewer/API timed out. The attempted public WMS request specified EPSG:4326 only as the requested query CRS.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point [51.8301487205853, 107.614176276488], land-plot WMS GetFeatureInfo, no unsafe fields requested

qualification.reason: Official cadastral-map discovery is evidenced, but the current viewer/API did not return a bounded parcel response; no adapter or runtime admission is qualified.

The official Buryatia source is a regional cadastral-valuation agency and was distinguished from the national Rosreestr/NSPD service; no Ulan-Ude municipal cadastral custodian was established.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native ID plus unchanged polygon was returned.
No owner, address, contact, title, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Raw request notes and timeout evidence are under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/7753/; prior logs and artifacts were not cleared.
uncertainty: The current NSPD public cadastral-map route and official Buryatia notice are evidenced, but service availability from this host, layer schema, CRS metadata, citywide coverage, update cadence, licensing, and exact-point parcel response remain unverified.
